At temperature 0.0, the model is deterministic — it outputs the highest-probability token every time. Given the same prompt, it will produce the same response every time. The model will pick one of H or T (whichever it assigns higher probability to) and output it consistently across all 100 calls.

If all 100 outcomes are identical (all H or all T), then no adjacent pair differs. The proportion of adjacent outcomes that differ would be 0.
